versions.subject: new rule for office directory traversal
versions.detection:
selection:
  ParentImage|endswith:
    - '\winword.exe'
    - '\excel.exe'
    - '\powerpnt.exe'
    - '\msaccess.exe'
    - '\mspub.exe'
    - '\eqnedt32.exe'
    - '\visio.exe'
  Image|contains:
    - '\Windows\System32\'
    - '\Windows\SysWOW64\'
  CommandLine:
    - '../../../..'
    - '..\..\..\..'
    - '..//..//..//..'
condition: selection
versions.spl: ParentImage IN ("*\\winword.exe", "*\\excel.exe", "*\\powerpnt.exe", "*\\msaccess.exe", "*\\mspub.exe", "*\\eqnedt32.exe", "*\\visio.exe") Image IN ("*\\Windows\\System32\\*", "*\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\*") CommandLine IN ("../../../..", "..\\..\\..\\..", "..//..//..//..")
